an10.50:5.2: When a mendicant is very learned … they have penetrated them theoretically,
an10.50:5.3: this warm-hearted quality makes for fondness and respect, conducing to inclusion, harmony, and unity, without dispute.
an10.50:6.2: When a mendicant has good friends, companions, and associates,
an10.50:6.3: this warm-hearted quality makes for fondness and respect, conducing to inclusion, harmony, and unity, without dispute.
an10.50:7.2: When a mendicant is easy to admonish, having qualities that make them easy to admonish, they’re patient and take instruction respectfully,
an10.50:7.3: this warm-hearted quality makes for fondness and respect, conducing to inclusion, harmony, and unity, without dispute.
an10.50:8.2: When a mendicant is deft and tireless in a diverse spectrum of duties for their spiritual companions, understanding how to go about things in order to complete and organize the work,
an10.50:8.3: this warm-hearted quality makes for fondness and respect, conducing to inclusion, harmony, and unity, without dispute.
an10.50:9.2: When a mendicant loves the teachings and is a delight to converse with, being full of joy in the teaching and training,
an10.50:9.3: this warm-hearted quality makes for fondness and respect, conducing to inclusion, harmony, and unity, without dispute.
an10.50:10.2: When a mendicant lives with energy roused up for giving up unskillful qualities and embracing skillful qualities, they’re strong, staunchly vigorous, not slacking off when it comes to developing skillful qualities,
an10.50:10.3: this warm-hearted quality makes for fondness and respect, conducing to inclusion, harmony, and unity, without dispute.
an10.50:11.2: When a mendicant is content with any kind of robes, almsfood, lodgings, and medicines and supplies for the sick,
an10.50:12.2: When a mendicant is mindful, they have utmost mindfulness and alertness, and can remember and recall what was said and done long ago,
an10.50:15.1: Dispute, and the two Roots of Dispute,
an10.50:15.2: at Kusinārā, and entering a royal compound;
